_doc: T3737 / docs/t-toolchain-parity.md: the first `--version` line of each tool that the prebuilt input hash folds in (tools/wt/cache_keys.py tool_versions, names cc, cmake, python3). Builder hosts must report exactly these (provision step toolchain-parity). Values are the owner PC container's, the toolchain the hash is computed under; bump all three together with the owner PC. build_image: the Debian 13 build container (tools/fleet/remote/builder-image/Dockerfile) that fleet.json hosts with build_container run builds and the probe in (docs/t-toolchain-parity.md); id is the docker image ID.
